notes_for_editor: The 1949 survey description is the only structural source and is solid: four-legged steel, a house with a pyramidal roof, about 110 ft. The 110 ft figure is the survey's overall height; the survey does not say whether it runs to the cab floor, so height_m is that figure converted, not a cab-floor height. The year in the datasheet designation (WAKEFIELD LOOKOUT TOWER 1949) is the description year, so it is not used as a build date. Gone status rests only on the association table; no removal date or post-1949 site note was found. The 1930 Forest Worker item on the Texas list page (steel towers protecting Polk, Tyler, Hardin and Liberty county land) does not name Wakefield, so it is left out. The TSHA entry is used only for the place name and community context. Budget used: 2 WebSearch calls, 6 page reads.
